refnamediv.refpurpose: Tests whether a polynomial over GF(p) is primitive

listitem.para: Polynomial of degree n: a row of exactly n + 1 integer coefficients in 0 .. p-1, constant term first, with a non-zero last coefficient.
Prime number: the characteristic of the field, at most 2^20.
Degree of f: an integer from 1 to 20, with p^n ≤ 2^20.
%t if f is primitive over GF(p), %f otherwise.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: A polynomial f of degree n over GF(p) is primitive when it is irreducible and its roots have multiplicative order p^n - 1, so that they generate the multiplicative group of GF(p^n). Only primitive polynomials can be used with gf_create_field.
The test computes the order of x modulo f: f is primitive exactly when f(0) ≠ 0 and that order is p^n - 1. The polynomial does not need to be monic.

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting: gf_is_primitive_polynomial([1 1 0 0 1], 2, 4) // T: 1 + x + x^4 gf_is_primitive_polynomial([1 0 0 1 1], 2, 4) // T: 1 + x^3 + x^4 gf_is_primitive_polynomial([1 1 1 1 1], 2, 4) // F: irreducible, but x^5 = 1

revdescription.para: Refactoring of the function/toolbox. Returns a boolean.
